versions.content: In case of a Sequence configured as Interruptible Sequence and according to [SWS_Spi_00125] requirement, the SPI Handler/Driver is allowed to suspend an already started Sequence transmission in favour of another Sequence with a higher priority Job (see SWS_Spi_00002 & SWS_Spi_00093). That means, at the end of a Job transmission (that belongs to the interruptible sequence) with anoth- er Sequence transmit request pending, the SPI Handler/Driver shall perform a re- scheduling in order to elect the next Job to transmit.
